pr_body:
Implemented support for disconnected state with TrayIcon.
Added some notification support (Windows and Linux).
Changed some logic to prevent hangs on clicks.

Updated logic for reconnect.
This fixes a case where using a wrong password could cause an infinite loop.

This fixes #5923
This fixes #5775
This fixes #5787
This fixes #5796
This fixes #5716

issue_context.title: Investigate hang with TrayIcon
issue_context.body:
The TrayIcon appears to hang after clicking "Open" when running in detached mode (`--no-hosted-server`).

Reported on Windows and Linux Mint:
https://forum.duplicati.com/t/tray-icon-wont-launch-after-update/19756
